question: Should this visibility-only skill shadowing hardening merge with a default doctor --lint warning and no denyShadowing config, or should the lint behavior and linked issue scope be narrowed first?
rationale: The code preserves documented precedence, but it changes default lint outcomes for intentional overrides and intentionally leaves the linked fail-closed policy request unresolved.

options.title: Land visibility after proof
options.body: Accept the default warning as intentional hardening once public Control UI proof is attached, and track denyShadowing separately if it remains desired.

options.title: Narrow the lint impact
options.body: Keep loader/status/CLI/UI visibility but make the doctor signal opt-in, lower severity, or suppressible before merge.

options.title: Pause for full policy
options.body: Hold the PR until warning behavior, fail-closed config, docs, and upgrade policy are designed together.

recommendation.title: Land visibility after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the default warning as intentional hardening once public Control UI proof is attached, and track denyShadowing separately if it remains desired.
